book.name: Akatecholonike
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akatecholonike

content: Ne Pauli, Silwano na Timocheyo. Tunnyandikila mangota lilongo lya bhando bha kwenio ku Tesolonike, bhubhabhii bhando bhake Chapanga Tate, na bha Bhambo Yecho Kilichitu. Tunnyopa Chapanga ampeke umbone na uteeke.
Ughome na kihobholelo cha ku Tesolonike
Ninchenguu Chapanga machiko ghoha kwa nhwalo gwino, na machiko ghoha putujhopa tunkomboka mangota.
Nhwalo palonge jha Chapanga Tate gwito, tukomboka mahengo ghino ghihuma mu kihobholelo chino na ghilangii upalo gwino, pumuhobhalela Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu kwa uhimbililo.
Makalongo bhito, twenga tumanye Chapanga ampahii na ahagwi kubhehe bhando bhake,

nhwalo Malobhe gha Mbone pughahikilila, ghakahikitii jhe kwa lilobhe tugha nambo helahela ikahikite kwa makakala gha Uhuke gwa Chapanga, kongo umanye njwe kubhehe lilobhe lyenio ndi lya uchakaka. Umanye kubhehe chitutamita pamonga na mangota, tukatamite mbone kuntangatii mangota.
Mangota mukatujhighe twenga na Bhambo. Pamonga na kung'ahichwa hake, mukapokii lilobhe lya kuhangana kuhumii kwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nhwalo mangota ndi nnandanikiho gwa kujhigwa kwa lilongo lya bhando bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu lyoha lya ku Makedoniya nuku Akaya.
Nhwalo gwa kughagha kwino lilobhe lya Bhambo likajhenile chi kwenio ku Makedoniya nuku Akaya tugha, nambo kihobholelo chiminacho kwa Chapanga kijhenile poha. Yene kibhii jhe chukujhonjekeya.
Bhando bheniya bhilonge nhwalo gwa mwanja gwito putuntyangila, na chimpokila, na chimuilekita inyagho, na kunhengela Chapanga jwabhii chakaka na ghome,
ngoheno tunnendelela Mwana gwake ahuluke kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga, ndi Yecho, Chapanga akayokiche kuhumii kwa bhando bhubhawile, na jwenio atughombole mu lilaka lya Chapanga lilihika.
